description: This header defines C++ wrapper structs and functions for media stream information, including audio and video stream and sample info, operators, and utility functions, used within the starboard media namespace.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Wrapper for SbMediaAudioStreamInfo containing media stream properties.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Wrapper for SbMediaAudioSampleInfo containing sample info.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Wrapper for SbMediaVideoStreamInfo containing video stream properties.

classes.name: VideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Wrapper for SbMediaVideoSampleInfo containing video sample info.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for AudioStreamInfo, VideoStreamInfo, and other media structs.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts wrapper structs to their corresponding SbMedia structs.

methods.name: GetStringRepresentation
methods.description: Returns string representation of byte data.

methods.name: GetMixedRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of byte data with specified line length.

methods.name: IsSDRVideo
methods.description: Determines if video is SDR based on parameters or mime type.

methods.name: GetBytesPerSample
methods.description: Returns byte size per sample for given sample type.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleInfoSubstantiallyDifferent
methods.description: Checks if two audio stream infos are substantially different.

methods.name: AudioDurationToFrames
methods.description: Converts duration in microseconds to frame count.

methods.name: AudioFramesToDuration
methods.description: Converts frame count to duration in microseconds.
